name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Plaque With Tassel
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a modern, elegant, and eye-catching finish.
    - Features a 2-layer acrylic construction for a more dimensional and premium display effect.
    - Layer 1 is made of transparent acrylic with 2-sided printing, creating the main personalized plaque design.
    - Layer 2 is made of mirror acrylic with no printing, adding a reflective decorative accent for a more luxurious appearance.
    - Each acrylic layer has a thickness of ~3mm, providing a sturdy yet lightweight structure.
    - Comes with a transparent acrylic base for stable standing display and a decorative tassel for an elegant finishing touch.
    - Tassel color options: Black, White, Dark Navy Blue, Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Cyan Blue, Maroon, Red, Deep Pink, Pink, Medium Purple, Lawn Green, Yellow Orange, Cornsilk.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
                     +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
                     +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Transparent acrylic base size: 2.36 x 2.36 in ~ 6 x 6 cm
    - Base height: 0.4 in ~ 1 cm
    - Base slot width: 0.12 in ~ 0.3 cm
    - Tassel length: 16 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1: 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2: no printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized plaque and a decorative keepsake display.
    - Designed to stand securely on desks, shelves, countertops, graduation tables, or memory corners.
    - The tassel adds a classic graduation-inspired accent, making the plaque more special and visually complete.
    - Suitable for graduation celebrations, photo displays, commemorative events, and personalized room décor.
    - Perfect for preserving milestone memories stylishly and elegantly.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for graduates, students, classmates, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for kindergarten, high school, college, and university graduation celebrations.
    - Ideal for graduation parties, senior keepsakes, and milestone memory displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, photos, class years, and meaningful messages.
    - Great for desk décor, shelf displays, and commemorative event decorations.
    - Adds a stylish, personal, and celebratory touch to any special occasion🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Plaque With Tassel

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
